name: Harkiva
source:
[spoiler]Originally one of the "always three" with Dakaria and Emma, Harkiva was [i]very[/i] close to Dakaria and "the best of us".[/spoiler]
Having discovered the [spoiler]negative effects of human blood[/spoiler], after being forced by tradition to drink her first drop and then studying the adults thereafter, Harkiva [spoiler]is the reason why the pact swore off of it.[/spoiler]

Even being "from an aristocratic family," she beared too much greed and ambition for someone who didn't know how to stop. [spoiler]So after the Circle found her, she changed into someone else and left the pact.[/spoiler] Possibly due to greed and possibly [spoiler]for her family's protection.[/spoiler] Either way, her actions [spoiler]made her the trampler of the seed of salvation she planted herself.[/spoiler] And now, she's not only one of the most powerful blood sorceresses Emma's ever seen. She's also [spoiler]the shadow, protegée, and "spoiled child of Izalith."[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Forgiven by Dakaria, but not by Emma, Harkiva's betrayal (or abandonment of the three-person pact)[/spoiler] seems to have caused the closest thing to a split between the two.
